rv.q: But I come to praise "Joseph" and what a well-toned, heartfelt production like this one does for a tired, stressed-out audience, not to bury it.

Throughout, the ensemble moves through the score’s divergent styles — from calypso to burlesque to ballad to hoedown — with verve and confidence, creating a show that’s rich in both substance and sparkle.
This gifted Director/Choreographer never fails to find an exciting and novel way to present a familiar musical that we think we already know.
This is a show the whole family will truly enjoy, and certainly brings the Old Testament to inspiring life.
Mak infuses the whole show with inclusion, love and heart.
The energy and enthusiasm of the ensemble taking various roles is joyful and contagious.
Let me tell you that the current production at Marriott Theatre in Lincolnshire is one of a kind— and superb!

cn.t: Critics praise this joyful, high-energy production for Amber Mak's fresh direction and vibrant choreography, calling it a perfect antidote to winter gloom, though one reviewer finds it overly reminiscent of a high school staging.
